meta.home: A mobile action game. Ride the creases between worlds, seal the Tears, bring down the Tyrants.
meta.fold: The story of Dimension Riders: the Fold, the Amber, the Mark, the Unfolded and the Riders.
meta.download: Download Dimension Riders for Android, free and offline.
meta.privacy: Dimension Riders privacy policy: no data collected, works offline.

hero.tagline: Ride the creases. Seal the Tears. Bring the worlds back into the fold.
hero.opening: No one knows who folded the worlds. No one knows if anyone did. The worlds lie in layers, each unaware of the others, glued by the Amber that hardens in the creases. And every piece of Amber, in every corner of the Fold, carries the same Mark. The Unfolded say it is a key. The Riders would rather not say. Both sides carry Amber. Only one of them wants to open.

ride.title: Ride the creases
ride.text: Every Tear is a path between two worlds. Push down it with twin-stick controls: one thumb moves, the other aims and fires.

seal.title: Seal the Tears
seal.text: Waves of creeps pour through. Clear them fast: the longer a Tear stays open, the wider it gets.

tyrants.title: Bring down the Tyrants
tyrants.text: At the end of every crease waits an Unfolded strong enough to hold the Tear open. Beat it, seal the Tear, and let your Shard pull you to the next one.

cta.title: Your Shard is pulling.
cta.text: Free. Offline. No ads, no accounts.
